title: "Debug Error"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| error: true

if (!require("devtools")) install.packages("devtools", repos="http://cran.us.r-project.org")
if (!require("HanPolNet")) {
    devtools::install("local_packages/HanPolNet", upgrade = "never")
    library(HanPolNet)
}

interaction_data_all_22_24 <- get_interaction_data(
    years = c(22, 23, 24),
    is_pollinator = TRUE,
    remove_zeros = TRUE,
    standardize = TRUE
)

# Construct info string
info <- paste(
    "ROWS:", nrow(interaction_data_all_22_24),
    "COLS:", paste(names(interaction_data_all_22_24), collapse="|"),
    "YEARS:", paste(unique(interaction_data_all_22_24$year), collapse="|")
)

# Check for plant column
found_plant <- intersect(c("plant_species", "plant_id", "plant"), names(interaction_data_all_22_24))
if(length(found_plant) > 0) {
    pcol <- found_plant[1]
    plants <- unique(interaction_data_all_22_24[[pcol]])
    info <- paste(info, "PL.SAMPLE:", paste(head(plants, 5), collapse="|"))
    
    # Check for Succisa
    targets <- c("Succisa pratensis", "Suc_pra", "Succisa_pratensis")
    matches <- targets[targets %in% plants]
    info <- paste(info, "SUCCISA_MATCH:", paste(matches, collapse="|"))
} else {
    info <- paste(info, "NO_PLANT_COL")
}

# CRASH WITH INFO
stop(paste("DEBUG_EXIT_START >>>", info, "<<< DEBUG_EXIT_END"))
```
